easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Stunt Double
description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Stunt Double's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Stunt Double's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Stunt Double's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.
